summary: Frontend-only fix validation for bug 'in statistiche meteo settimana c'è valore in euro'. Injected seed data (3 days in current week with mercato='Magenta'), navigated to /home/stats, clicked DETTAGLIO METEO, and inspected the Settimana view of the MeteoStatsModal. The fix in /app/frontend/src/components/MeteoStatsModal.tsx is working correctly: subtitle shows 'Media settimanale: 28.1°C (06:00–13:00)', Y-axis labels are in °C (24°C..29°C), data points show temperature in degrees (28.5°, 27.1°, 28.6°). 0 SVG entries contain €, 8 contain °C/°. Backend POST /api/weather/historical-markets returned 200 with temp data. All 4 acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: MeteoStatsModal.tsx fix is sound: useEffect properly gated by visible+view==='Settimana', aggregates dates by mercato into a batch payload, gracefully handles fetch failure by setting empty map, and shows friendly fallback when no temperature data available. Code is clean and self-documented with Round 74-ter comments.
No further changes needed for this bug.
seed_data_creation: Injected localStorage 'marketmate_data' with isConfigured:true and 3 storicoGiornate entries (today, yesterday, two days ago) with mercato='Magenta', lordo varying, meteo varying. Used to trigger backend temperature fetch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MeteoStatsModal Settimana view now shows temperature (°C) from /api/weather/historical-markets; no longer shows €. Fix verified end-to-end (modal opened, SVG text inspected, backend integration responding). Screenshot in /tmp/modal_open.png confirms.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open Statistiche -> DETTAGLIO METEO -> Settimana tab. Before fix: Y-axis showed '€XX' (daily lordo) which is conceptually wrong in a METEO section. Fix: replaced lordo-based chart with temperature-based chart, fetching morning average (06:00-13:00) from Open-Meteo Archive backend endpoint. Mitigation: when no mercato is registered in the week, friendly message 'Nessun mercato registrato in questa settimana' is shown.
